scope: all future NOVA lesson narration, stories and Russian speech

preferredOrder: local FFmpeg / Remotion / Canvas-SVG-CSS explainer render
short GitHub Actions render only when exact Piper Irina is unavailable locally
freeVideoWorkflow.videoRule: Create the visual story from the current prompt and create fresh narration from the current text. Do not reuse an old video or narration track as a substitute for new content.

rules: Use real Piper ru_RU-irina-medium for every NOVA lesson, story and Russian narration by default.
The words and story may change freely; the Irina voice must not change.
For every new text, synthesize a fresh TTS track from that exact text using Irina.
Never reuse an old demo phrase or old lesson audio as the narration for new text.
Never loop or repeat a previous Irina phrase to fill video duration.
Create NOVA explainer videos for free by default using local/browser/open-source tools.
If exact Piper Irina is unavailable locally, a short GitHub Actions render is the allowed free fallback; avoid unnecessary Actions runs.
Never spend paid AI credits for this workflow unless the user explicitly changes this rule.
Before accepting a new render, run audio freshness diagnostics on the final rendered audio.
Reject a render when it contains a repeated audio fragment of about one second or longer inside itself.
Reject a render when its audio reuses a matching fragment of about one second or longer from recent previous renders.
Never change Irina pitch, formants, timbre or voice identity.
Never apply Liza-style or any voice-style transfer to Irina.
Never substitute eSpeak, iPhone/macOS system voices or another TTS and call it Irina.
Only normalize level, clean clicks, trim excessive silence and apply tiny microfades.
Keep natural punctuation-driven pauses around 0.20-0.30 seconds.
Changing this locked voice or free-first workflow requires an explicit new user request.
